title: What makes Qlozet different
subtitle: Four pillars unify our ecosystem: precision, personalization, productivity, and trust.

items.title: Precision Fit
items.description: AI body measurement from a hands-free phone scan: the phone sends only an outline, and the model estimates the girths and lengths a tailor needs.

items.title: Personalized Styles
items.description: Configurable style options (neckline, sleeves, length, closures, trims) with vendor-verified defaults and pricing logic.

items.title: Unified Workflow
items.description: From inspiration to fabric selection, bespoke order, production tracking and delivery, managed in one place.

items.title: Trust & Safety
items.description: Verified vendors, dispute resolution, and customer details kept private from vendors.
